xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi: Pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation, which became effective on June 5, 2026, as previously intimated to the stock exchanges on June 6, 2026, the shares of Archidply Industries Limited held by Ravi Marketing & Services Private Limited vested in Assam Timber Products Private Limited, and the shares held by Vanraj Suppliers Private Limited vested in Shree Shyam Tea Private Limited. Consequently, the number of promoter entities has changed; however, the aggregate shareholding of the promoter group in the Company remains unchanged pursuant to the Scheme.
